text: Ethics in AI is becoming a very important topic today. As artificial intelligence systems make more decisions in our lives, we must think about bias and fairness. If the data used to train AI is not balanced, the system may treat some groups unfairly. Privacy is another serious concern, because AI often collects and uses personal information. People also need transparency, which means they should understand how AI makes its choices. Finally, responsible AI development means companies and governments must work together to create rules that protect everyone. Only in this way can we enjoy the benefits of AI while avoiding its dangers.
